PK-01.note: floating card over the source tab; one Peek per window; links inside navigate it

PK-02.note: other-site (eTLD+1) clicks and target=_blank in pinned tabs/Favorites; same-site navigates

PK-03.note: Shift-click in any tab; link menu 'Open Link in Peek'

PK-04.note: meeting links open a tab; routing rules (settings.linkRules) win; rules UI is the settings lane's

PK-05.note: inset card, shadow, dimmed page area, Close / Open as Tab / Split buttons with shortcut tooltips; no toolbar (AP-07 not built)

PK-06.note: spring grow from the link, dim, quick shrink-fade, reduced motion; no interactive dismiss gesture

PK-07.note: ⌘O / button: card morphs to the frame, live page becomes a selected Today tab (routing rules apply)

PK-08.note: button and animation wired; uses split.addTab once the split lane merges, else opens as a tab

PK-09.note: Esc (after fullscreen), ⌘W, ×, click outside; archived as from 'peek'

PK-10.note: ⌘Z right after closing, or ⌘⇧T, reopens on the same page with history

PK-11.note: links, back/forward, reload, zoom, copy URL, devtools act on the Peek; sidebar address does not show the Peek host

PK-12.note: settings.peekExternalLinks / peekShiftClick honoured; toggles UI belongs to the settings lane

PK-13.note: no sidebar row; sidebar stays usable; selecting another tab, Space or window dismisses (reopenable)

PK-16.note: Mini Window links never Peek; target=_blank stays in the Mini Window

MW-01.note: separate small window, one floating tab, main window untouched

MW-02.note: open-url / second-instance / argv links open a Mini Window; same URL resurfaces it; routing rules first

MW-03.note: slim top bar: controls, favicon+host (click/⌘L edits), Open in…, profile pill; inset page card; neutral theme

MW-04.note: last-used size/position, 24 px cascade, fade-in on macOS/Windows, best-effort above fullscreen on macOS; no scale

MW-05.note: ⌘O to the most recent Space, Open in… / ⌘⌥O (⌘⇧O) native Space menu; live page, no reload

MW-06.note: ⌘⌥N (global shortcut outside e2e) opens a pre-rendered blank window with a focused lookup bar; Esc/⌘W close

MW-07.note: ⌘⌥-click and link menu 'Open Link in Mini Window'; ⌘⌥-click on a sidebar row not built (sidebar lane)

MW-08.note: any number; Show/Hide All action and macOS dock menu

MW-09.note: close and idle auto-close (settings.miniWindowArchiveAfterMs, 6 h, 0 = never; not while audible) archive with from 'mini'

MW-10.note: profile pill/menu reopens the page in another profile; remembered per site

MW-11.note: settings.miniWindowForExternalLinks off: tabs in the most recent or chosen Space (externalLinksSpace)

MW-12.note: fullscreen video fills the window, copy URL, devtools, downloads via the session; no captures

MW-14.note: all platforms with Ctrl+Alt+N / Ctrl+O / Ctrl+Alt+O; no tray or jump-list fallback

MW-15.note: warm spare window takes keys at once, page loads before the window shows; Open in… has no fly-to-sidebar motion
